Miss.NodeEnvNote: NODE_OPTIONS 传给 Node 的模块路径是文件路径，Node 的 ESM 加载器只认 file: 协议（否则报 ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME，进程直接退出），启动前已改写成 file:// URL。

NODE_OPTIONS passes a file path where a module URL is expected; Node's ESM loader only accepts the file: protocol (otherwise it reports ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME and exits). It was rewritten to a file:// URL before starting.
